stores.name: CNY 2026
stores.infoHtml:
NTU WSC RSPID Chinese New Year Order Form 2026 新年订单 

Greetings from NTU RSPID!


Chinese New Year (CNY) is just around the corner, and RSPID will be selling CNY goodies as part of our annual canvassing effort. All proceeds will be used to support RSPID's weekly sessions for our service users!


Important Notice: 


1. Almost all cookies contain milk, egg, wheat, or dairy.

2. All products are not halal certified but contains no pork & no lard.


Payment: PayNow/Bank Transfer/Cash (if unable to do online banking). 


Collection Point: Woodlands Garden School on 7 February 2026, 2-6 PM.


The last order must be placed by MONDAY, 26 January 2026, 11:59 PM. 


If you have any questions, feel free to contact Alicia at 93842859 (WhatsApp) or @tongtonq (Telegram)! We look forward to your support! 😊


Brought to you by:

Regular Service Project for the Intellectually Disabled (RSPID)

A project under NTU's Welfare Services Club (WSC)


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


农历新年就快到了，RSPID将会销售农历新年美食作为我们年度筹款活动的一部分，所有收入将用于支持RSPID每周为我们的服务对象举办的活动！


重要事项：

1. 几乎所有年饼都含有牛奶、鸡蛋、小麦或乳制品。

2. 所有年饼都没有HALAL认证。


付款方式: PayNow/ 银行转账 / 现金支付 (如果无法进行网上银行交易)。

取货点: Woodlands Garden School 校内(2026年2月7日一，下午2时至6时) 设有领取点。


最后订单截止日期为2026年1月26日星期一，下午1159点。


如果您有任何疑问，欢迎联系Alicia，电话为 93842859 (WhatsApp)！


我们期待您的支持！:)

stores.name: Mid-Autumn Festival 2026
stores.infoHtml:
🥮 Warm greetings from NTU WSC RSPID! 🥮


We're back with our annual mooncake sale, and we'd love for you to be a part of it! Every box purchased goes towards supporting our beneficiaries with intellectual disabilities. 💛


This year, we're proud to partner with My Mum's Cookies as our mooncake supplier. With over 20 years of baking experience, the mooncakes are crafted with quality ingredients and an emphasis on healthier options. 🍃 


Whether you're a fan of timeless classics or keen to try trendy flavours, there's something for everyone. All mooncakes are Halal-certified. Vegan and vegetarian-friendly options are available too! 🌱


So treat your loved ones to delicious mooncakes and make a meaningful difference at the same time. Every purchase goes a long way in empowering our beneficiaries to lead fulfilling lives. 💪


Orders can be placed through this online form. The form closes on 6 September 2026, 11:59PM so order early to avoid missing out!


📍 Collection: Woodlands Garden School, 19 September 2026

📞 Questions? Contact David at 9787 2684!

📸 More info on our Instagram


We look forward to your support this Mid-Autumn Festival! 🌕


Yours sincerely,

Regular Service Project for the Intellectually Disabled (RSPID)

A project under NTU's Welfare Services Club (WSC)
